name: Synthetic NSCLC patient — 42 years old
description: 42-year-old patient with stage III non-small cell lung cancer. Previously received chemotherapy. Lives in Kansas City, Missouri. EGFR mutation status is unknown.

trials.title: Synthetic trial: targeted therapy after prior chemotherapy
trials.eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Patient is at least 18 years old
- Histologically confirmed non-small cell lung cancer
- Known EGFR activating mutation
Exclusion Criteria:
- Active uncontrolled infection
trials.brief_summary: Synthetic oncology study for demonstration only.

trials.title: Synthetic trial: first-line therapy for untreated NSCLC
trials.eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Adult patient at least 18 years old
- Non-small cell lung cancer diagnosis
Exclusion Criteria:
- Any prior systemic chemotherapy
trials.brief_summary: Synthetic first-line oncology study for demonstration only.

trials.title: Synthetic trial: investigational immunotherapy in advanced NSCLC
trials.eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Adults 18 years or older
- Stage III or IV non-small cell lung cancer
Exclusion Criteria:
- Active autoimmune disease requiring immunosuppressive medications
trials.brief_summary: Synthetic oncology study with additional medical screening required.
